as_told.title: Mario's account of starting Lazar's car for fear of a bomb

plain: Around 1989 and 1990 in Las Vegas, Bob Lazar's locked car kept turning up unlocked, and he and a friend feared someone had planted a bomb in it. Lazar is a man at the center of a long-running UFO story. If the account is true, someone was getting into his car again and again to frighten or watch him. Lazar tells Michels this himself. He says they would lock the car and test the door, 'because it had happened before,' and say, 'All right, it's locked,' only to find it open later. A researcher named Luigi Vendittelli passes on what Lazar's friend Mario Woods told him. Woods said, 'I was with Bob all the time and we were scared that something was going to blow up.' Woods says he was going through such hard times that he didn't care, so he told Lazar to 'stay out' while he tried starting the car himself. The two accounts agree on the fear, and Woods's version adds that he was the one who took the risk.
